title: I'm looking for people to try the alpha of my first game!
author: Cautious-Current9522
selftext:
**Game Title: The Last Wardfire**

**Playable Link:** [https://giovanniscalmati.itch.io/the-last-wardfire](https://giovanniscalmati.itch.io/the-last-wardfire)

**Platform:** PC Windows

**Description:** It's a 2D fantasy survivor/roguelite with village building. You build and develop your village, go on expeditions to fight hordes of enemies and bosses, collect resources and bring them back home. Every three expeditions, your village gets attacked and you have to defend it.

I'm using Claude as my main coding assistant. I come up with the ideas, discuss mechanics and features with it, and then use it to help implement everything in the actual project. I test the results myself, point out what doesn't work and we go through another iteration.

For the graphics, I'm using purchased Minifantasy asset packs rather than AI-generated artwork. For things like the logo and other original artwork, I'd prefer to hire artists on Fiverr.
